selectionRules.objectiveCases: Reused six prior registered B/C objective cases; five exact observations at floor((n-1)*{0,.25,.5,.75,1)).
selectionRules.disagreement: Top three registered boundaries by winner-center distance descending; tie seed then anchor index.
selectionRules.lowOverlap: Top three by registered winner-X Jaccard ascending; tie seed then anchor index.
selectionRules.agreement: Top three by registered winner-X Jaccard descending; tie seed then anchor index.
selectionRules.nonentry: Top three by maximin of separate within-channel strongest-nonentry/overall ratios; display selection only, no B/C evidence score or mechanism.
selectionRules.entryQuietStrengthening: First chronological shared boundary with available B and C cases meeting the labeled descriptive condition; not a gate.
